description: Generate ready-to-merge robots.txt rules to allow or block AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot and more). Presets: training-only (block training crawlers, keep AI search and user-initiated fetchers), block-all, allow-all. Note: robots.txt is a request, not access control.

block.description: Alternative to preset: exact bot names to block, e.g. ["GPTBot","CCBot"].

name: generate_robots_txt
title: Generate robots.txt rules for AI crawlers
